question: If the height of a right circular cone is 24 cm and radius of its base is 10.5 cm, then the volume of right circular cone (in cm³) is: Takе л = (22)/(7)
solution:
**Given:**

Height of the right circular cone (h) = 24 cm

Radius of the base (r) = 10.5 cm

**Formula Used:**

Volume of a right circular cone = (1/3) × π × r² × h

Take π = 22/7

**Calculation:**

Volume of the cone = (1/3) × (22/7) × (10.5)² × 24

(10.5)² = 110.25

⇒ Volume = (1/3) × (22/7) × 110.25 × 24

⇒ Volume = (22/21) × 110.25 × 24

⇒ Volume = (22 × 110.25 × 24) / 21

⇒ Volume = 2772 cm³

**The volume of the right circular cone is 2772 cm³.**
